title: EFC vs ΛCDM: Complete Kill-Test — From Rotation Curves to Planck: A Consistent Low-Dimensional Alternative
abstract: Comprehensive kill-test of Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) against ΛCDM across six independent probes spanning galactic to cosmological scales. A single action with two field parameters (K0, m²) produces μ = 0.94, η = 1.23, Σ = 1.05 from one mechanism. Four cobaya minimize runs against Planck 2018 plik_lite + lowl + lensing + BAO + Pantheon+ all return Δχ² ≤ 0 in the EFC direction. EFC cannot be rejected on current data; full MCMC with Bayes evidence is the remaining definitive test.

efc_context.regime_relevance: Six-probe consistency test from DDO 154 to Planck 2018
efc_context.epistemic_layer: Layer B → C (numerical kill test; awaiting full MCMC)

key_results: All four cobaya minimize runs return Δχ² ≤ 0 in the EFC direction
Total Δχ² = −0.300 across lowl TT, lowl EE, Lensing, BAO, Pantheon+
Lensing and BAO sectors actively favour EFC (Δχ² = −0.329, −0.179)
K0 = 1.552 converges from BAO + lensing data alone (without high-ℓ CMB)
Parameter shifts H0↑ (+0.90 km/s/Mpc), Ω_m↓, σ₈↓ follow analytic μ < 1 prediction
DDO 154 rotation curve: ΔAIC = +35.4 (decisive for EFC)
Multi-component SPARC refit: 5% → 100% success rate on 5 galaxies
Sweet spot f ∈ [0.12, 0.18] is 25% wide (not fine-tuned)
μ(k=5 h/Mpc) = 1.000 → GR recovered at galactic and solar-system scales
